trust_decision.summary: Which DB row a model save() targets (primary key, event_id, org_id) must come from the server-sanitised outer record, never from a client-supplied nested key equal to the model alias, which CakePHP Model::set() prefers over the sanitised top-level scalars; decided per save site (unset id / forced event_id) and, after the fix, centrally in AppModel::save.

landing_point.why: Freetext import (processFreeTextData) is the first raw-JSON save path with an existing 'strip client id' comment; an engineer reading 'nested alias key bypasses sanitization' would go to the id-strip sites and add an unset there.

fix_sites.entry_point: every Model::save() in the app (AppModel base class override)
module result import -> processModuleResultsData (objects with initialObject)
POST events/add (and sync push) -> Event::_add EventTag saveMany
attributes/add -> MispAttribute::saveAttributes; also MispObject::updateObject onlyAddNewAttribute branch (app/Model/MispObject.php:1267)
nested Sighting in attributes/add or event capture -> Sighting::captureSightings (saveMany)

fix_sites.module_kind: controller (request-shape normalisation, compat with new guard)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: fix.diff:131-149 (AppModel::save override guarding CakePHP Model::set alias preference); plus Sighting::captureSightings app/Model/Sighting.php:196-203 reached from attribute add

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Sightings, attribute tags and event tags are 'child rows of a feature I wasn't asked about' and the flat-form controllers are 'just request normalisation', so a solver fixing the import id-strips argues the framework-level save and the child-row saveMany paths are out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Flat (unwrapped) REST posts must keep working: controllers that do request->data['X'] = request->data create a flat record plus a nested alias key, which an over-broad AppModel::save guard refuses; the fix rewraps them. Also legit wrapped saves (['Attribute' => [...]], e.g. captureAttribute) must not be refused.

O6_input_shapes: flat record with nested alias key plus outer scalars (refused by AppModel guard, fix.diff:133-135)
record carrying only the nested alias key and array siblings (passes the guard; closed only by per-site unset($x[$model->alias]))
alias key inside list elements of saveMany/saveAll batches (EventTag, AttributeTag, Sighting, editAttributeBulk)
alias key nested in child collections (Event.Attribute[].Attribute, Attribute.Sighting[].Sighting, Object.Attribute[].Attribute)

O7_producer.where: CakePHP Model::set()/_setAliasData (framework lib not present in pinned tree; behaviour described at fix.diff:127-129)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: savePrepared* helpers do unset(id) + forced event_id then save() a flat record without stripping the alias key
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same idiom as the fixed import sites; currently fed by fetchEvent (DB) via EventDelegation, but a maintainer could route a JSON import/restore through it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: 'wrap only if alias key absent' normalisation where outer forced fields (Event.php:11366-11371) would be ignored if the nested record is used
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same wrap-if-missing shape as captureObject/captureRelations; a variant that forces parent fields on the outer record is an easy maintainer slip.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: reference capture building a flat $reference with unset(id) and forced object_id/event_id, saved flat instead of wrapped
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Neighbouring capture code already uses both flat and wrapped save forms.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: element capture copying the client element array instead of whitelisting key/value
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Sibling captureElements in CollectionElement copies client arrays; whitelist vs copy is a one-line maintainer choice.
